_comment: Connector-side test fixtures for the shared dev WHMCS (hub + connector on the same install). Applied by VpnHood.WHMCS/tests/bootstrap/init-skeleton.sh — the fixture spec lives here because it is connector domain knowledge; the idempotent apply engine (skeleton.php) lives in the hub repo, which owns the dev environment. ${VARS} are substituted from env by the engine.

addons._comment: Connector installation config: point the connector at the dev Hub with the test partner credentials. ApiSecret is stored plaintext — HubClient::decryptSetting tolerates that by design.

products.name: One-Month Premium Code
products._moduleSettings: configoption1 = downstreamRef → the hub product mapped to the test partner

products.name: One-Month Premium Code (Subscription)
products._moduleSettings: recurring variant, mapped to the hub subscription product

buyer._role: The reseller's end customer: buys the connector products; the connector fulfils by ordering from the Hub. Lives here because the buyer belongs to the connector side.
